header: Day zero: which tables a real place would already have rows in on an ordinary day before anyone started watching. Skill day-one-in-motion; owner, Nov 14, 2026: 'The town must be in motion on day one... not just town, but country and state. Remember, it's all one simulation.' A row says stock (a real place has this on day 0), flow-only (a log or event after day 0), or unsure (none left: the Account lead called all 67 on Nov 14). Every stock row is checked by src/core2/day-zero.test.ts at the two pinned places. A stock row that is still empty carries knownRed: the id of the pool item that fixes it, never a stopgap id (no new stopgaps). The known-red list may only shrink: the test fails if a known-red table has rows (remove the mark), and tests/guards/day-zero.test.ts fails if a knownRed table is not in tests/guards/day-zero-baseline.json. Adding to that baseline needs the CTO's word, since it means a new gap in the opening. A new module (a MODULE_ID in src/core2) must appear in modules below or the guard fails: answer the day-0 question for it, at town, state and federal level. filledBy says how soon the world fills the table: day 1 (the first step seats it), day 31, or year 1 (measured at the two pinned places, the later of the two). A knownRed row with knownRedPlaces is red only at those place keys; elsewhere the table must have rows. Test for a call (Account lead, Nov 14): would a real place on the start date already have this under way? A row with when: filing-window-open is required only where a contest's filing window is open on the start date. Only a table that exists solely because of a player act may be left empty, and those are listed in playActOnly. Who may add a known-red entry: the CTO, by editing tests/guards/day-zero-baseline.json in the same pull request; the guard fails any known-red table that is not in the baseline or whose pool item file does not exist.

measured.warmUp: Known-red marks measured with a 31-day warm-up (OPENING_WARMUP_DAYS in src/bench/world.ts, src/core2/player-warm-up.ts) at the two pinned places on train head b7ed6337: a table is red where it is still empty after the warm-up.
